items.title: Dink Johnson Interview, 1950-11-12
items.q: Dirty Baby, Dirty Baby, won't you let me hold you in the cream of our love? I've been there all the while.

ctx.x: You know any Matt Waller students, Dink? No. Amos Behavin? No. Tony Haxington.

Dirty Baby, Dirty Baby, won't you let me hold you in the cream of our love? I've been there all the while. And I'd love to have a baby, and it might as well be you. Dirty Baby, come mine, come mine.
